entries.title: Whisperwood Watch
entries.consequence: Three Ash Slimes plus three Ash Motes earn 36 crowns; alternatively two logs plus one ration establish a refuge for 24 crowns, unlocking quiet-road healing (20 vitality / five minutes). Both advance the chapter.

entries.title: Scout’s Report
entries.consequence: Recover the patrol signal with two kills/two motes, or compare Rowan’s departure log and Dalen’s gate account at camp. Different objectives and earned knowledge; both earn the Ashvale seal.

entries.title: Redfen Patrol
entries.consequence: Clear the direct trail with three kills/three resin, or spend three resin covering twelve active seconds at a signal. Diversion changes the following reserve-medicine cost from two to four bottles.

entries.title: Marsh Samples
entries.consequence: Distill two fresh Fen Stalker samples to unlock a venom-for-medicine barter, or reserve and deliver two/four potions, depleting shared shop stock until normal delivery. All combinations earn the seal.

entries.title: Clear the Moor
entries.consequence: Three skeleton defeats/three Grave Iron, or permanently repurpose one spare Buckler at the warning frame. Equipped copies are protected. The warning chosen sets the open vigil station order.

entries.title: A Weaver’s Thread
entries.consequence: Two fresh Weaver defeats/two silk for a covered vigil (28 crowns/20 XP), or witness the two Highmoor stations in the requested order and close an open vigil (18 crowns/30 XP). No player vows; both earn the seal.

entries.title: Pass Watch
entries.consequence: Four Frostmarch defeats/four shards for 55 crowns, or a two-dial pressure puzzle for 40 crowns; venting earns knowledge that halves the following silk requirement.

entries.title: Cold Silk
entries.consequence: Two fresh Weaver defeats and one/two silk restore the ward for 36 crowns/24 XP; alternatively convert the town control and fit a field shutter linkage for 24 crowns/36 XP. Persistent beacon mode and town response; all combinations earn the seal.
